name: desarmadero
description: Archived client prototype: an operations system for an auto-dismantling yard (SvelteKit + Cloudflare D1), with the full discovery-to-prototype paper trail (call, PRD, spec). Live demo inside.

paragraphs: An operations system for an auto-dismantling yard (a desarmadero): the business that buys vehicles, takes them apart, and sells the used parts. It replaces a workflow of paper budget sheets, WhatsApp, and Excel with one digital flow — counter sale → dismantle order → cash desk → yard map → dismantler.
Live demo: — password asado. Sign in, switch between roles, and walk the whole flow.
This is an archived prototype I built for a client as a work sample. It's anonymized and seeded with fake data. The story behind it is below.
features: With current tooling, a prototype is quick to build.
It's the clearest way to confirm I actually understood what he was asking for.
It lets the client click through the idea. That's usually when you find out whether what someone described is what they really need.
It shows I'll put in extra work to get it right before any money changes hands.
